en_US.title: Black Keel Contract Approach
en_US.scanner: The first scene is a contract machine, not a heroic briefing.
en_US.field_note: The player starts by accepting a bad professional decision.
en_US.terminal: OPENING BEAT: Black Keel presents a claim, lien relief, oxygen addenda, payload custody and a narrow orbital window. The player accepts because debt and blacklist pressure make refusal expensive.
en_US.audio: The ship does not welcome you. It calculates you.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The opening should make the player a working Marauder before the ocean appears. The job is legal enough to launch and dirty enough to matter.
en_US.external_site: Black Keel Contract Approach defines the first playable pressure: contract before catastrophe.

en_US.title: Drop Capsule Damage Sequence
en_US.scanner: The trap is engineering: the descent package survives by spending its way home.
en_US.field_note: Crash damage must be readable before it is explained.
en_US.terminal: DAMAGE SEQUENCE: warped crush-frame, lost high-gain, flooded ascent avionics, torn flotation/heat-shield ring and unreliable emergency buoy. The capsule can keep you alive; it cannot leave.
en_US.audio: The ocean did not lock the door. It bent the hinge.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The first hour needs a physical reason for staying. Every broken part should become a future repair object or route pressure.
en_US.external_site: Drop Capsule Damage Sequence makes stranding visible and repairable.

en_US.title: Shallow Annex P-63 Pump Room
en_US.scanner: The first safe room is a machine that barely wins.
en_US.field_note: Safety should feel maintained, not cozy.
en_US.terminal: P-63 BEAT: the player hand-pumps floodwater, seats a cold seal, reads a drifting gauge and earns a dry pocket. The annex is safe because a machine is still arguing with the sea.
en_US.audio: A room is alive here only while something works.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Shallow Annex P-63 teaches HECTON-8 through action: pump, seal, read pressure, distrust clean labels.
en_US.external_site: Shallow Annex P-63 Pump Room is the first-hour survival tutorial without turning into a tutorial room.

ko_KR.field_note: Draft KO localization pending native pass. The first Atlas sign should be small, useful and ethically dirty.
ko_KR.terminal: Draft KO localization pending native pass. FIRST TRACE: biofilm seals a cable wound around a human object; tiny organisms repeat acoustic pings; a drone ignores the body and services the joint. Atlas is repairing a system, not honoring a person.
ko_KR.audio: Draft KO localization pending native pass. The sea learned the manual badly.
ko_KR.in_game_wiki: Draft KO localization pending native pass. The first Atlas trace should preserve shallow beauty while revealing the damaged repair logic that will dominate the deep.
ko_KR.external_site: Draft KO localization pending native pass. First Atlas Repair Trace introduces biomechanical horror before the player reaches real darkness.
